step1_analysis.description: A bipolar differential oscillator circuit using inductive loading at the collectors and bases, with capacitive cross-coupling or emitter degeneration. It forms the core of a high-frequency VCO, though tuning varactors are omitted in this simplified schematic.

paper_reference.title: A 190-GHz VCO With 20.7% Tuning Range Employing an Active Mode Switching Block in a 130 nm SiGe BiCMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). Using 1nH inductors and ~1pF effective capacitance in the testbench.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 190 GHz reported in the paper relies on highly optimized mm-wave passives and SiGe HBTs. In a generic testbench with standard 1nH/1pF components, it will oscillate in the low GHz range.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on bias current and tank impedance. With ~20mA bias and 50-ohm equivalent tank impedance, amplitude is roughly I * R.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard large-signal oscillation swing limited by VDD (1.8V) and transistor saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. Base bias via 5k resistor gives ~200uA base current, leading to ~20mA collector current (beta=100). P = 1.8V * 20mA = 36mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the bias resistor R2 and the current gain of the generic NPN model.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify oscillation startup, measure oscillation frequency, output amplitude, and DC power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* DUT (with component values added for simulation)
Q1 n7 n6 n3 npn
L1 n4 n6 1n
L2 n0 n4 1n
L3 VDD n7 1n
R1 n2 0 50
Q2 n1 n0 n5 npn
L4 VDD n1 1n
L5 n3 0 1n
R2 VDD n4 5k
C1 n2 n5 1p
L6 n5 0 1n
C2 n2 n3 1p

* Generic NPN model since the netlist uses 'npn'
.model npn npn is=1e-16 bf=100 cjc=50f cje=50f tf=10p

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(n7)=1.8 v(n1)=0 v(n6)=1.0 v(n0)=0.5

.control
* Run transient analysis with UIC to use initial conditions
tran 5p 20n uic

* Measure oscillation frequency
meas tran t_start trig v(n7) val=1.0 rise=15 targ v(n7) val=1.0 rise=16
let f_osc = 1 / t_start
print f_osc

* Measure output amplitude
meas tran v_max max v(n7) from=10n to=20n
meas tran v_min min v(n7) from=10n to=20n
let v_amp = (v_max - v_min) / 2
print v_amp

* Measure DC power consumption
let p_dc = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print p_dc

quit
.endc
